title: Encrypted secret bundle reference (v1alpha2)
description: Compact, embeddable REFERENCE to an encrypted, single-use secrets bundle whose public metadata lives in v1alpha1/secrets-bundle-manifest.schema.json. TARGET-STATE contract. It carries ONLY logical names and pointers so that a PersonalStack lock or an AssistantHandoff can point at the bundle WITHOUT inlining the manifest or any secret. It MUST NOT contain any secret value or ciphertext; the value only exists encrypted (age/X25519, ADR-0005) out of band and inside the Runtime local vault after import.

bundle_id.description: Opaque id of the encrypted bundle this reference points at.

manifest_ref.description: Path/URL to the PUBLIC secrets-bundle-manifest (metadata only, never values).

recipient.description: Instance the bundle was encrypted for. The private key never leaves the instance.

scheme.description: age/X25519 envelope encryption. Encryption only, never signing (ADR-0005).

refs.description: Logical secret references carried by the bundle. NAMES and target services only; NEVER values.

ref_name.description: Logical reference name (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). A NAME, not a value.
